# Vuorikosken Mylly

> A water mill built in 1893 in Myllykylä, Sammatti, in the town of Lohja, Uusimaa, Finland. Today it is a summer café with a gluten-free spread of bakes (plus wheat cinnamon buns on a separate table), a second-hand interior and vintage clothing shop, a summer art gallery, a small event room and two small off-grid B&B cabins by the mill pond. Open 11–17 on holiday weekends from Easter to late August and Thu–Sun from 17 June to 8 August (2027), then 11–16 on All Saints' and Father's Day weekends and Advent weekends (Christmas shop). Winter break until mid-April.

- Address: Tavolantie 18, 09220 Sammatti (Lohja), Finland
- Phone and WhatsApp: +358 44 016 5047
- Email: antti.jakola@hotmail.com
- Bus: Lohja to Sammatti, Myllykylä stop, then a 200 m walk

## Pages

- [Café](https://www.vuorikoskenmylly.com/en/cafe): gluten-free and lactose-free cakes and pies made on the farm (€5.90 a slice), a vegan option daily, wheat cinnamon buns, coffee/tea/cocoa €2.90, own iced tea and iced latte €2.40; whole cakes to order €39 (serves 12, two weeks notice); 50 seats with terraces; card, cash, MobilePay; pets welcome.
- [Vintage shop](https://www.vuorikoskenmylly.com/en/vintage-shop): second-hand interiors, vintage clothing, the farm's artisan treats, local crafts; Christmas shop on Advent weekends.
- [Art gallery](https://www.vuorikoskenmylly.com/en/art-gallery): open Thu–Sun 17 June–8 August 2027; four artists each summer; room hire €100 for 8 days, 25% commission; applications for summer 2028 open 17 June–8 August 2027.
- [Event room](https://www.vuorikoskenmylly.com/en/event-room): long table for meetings and small family parties, bookable 15 May–15 August, €50 per hour.
- [Stay](https://www.vuorikoskenmylly.com/en/stay): Mutterimökki and Rantayksiö, 1–2 people, €59 a night with bed linen, no electricity; breakfast €10, shore sauna €7 with a stay or €10 without (sauna bookable all year). Cabins bookable 15 May–15 August; 2027 bookings open at Easter, 27 March 2027, by text or WhatsApp.
- Events 2027: Easter treats 27–29 Mar, Simaralli (May Day) 1–2 May, Mother's Day 8–9 May, School's out Party 5–6 Jun, Christmas in July 24–25 Jul, Venetian night 28–29 Aug, All Saints' 30–31 Oct, Father's Day 13–14 Nov, Christmas opening 27–28 Nov.
- [Hours and contact](https://www.vuorikoskenmylly.com/en/contact)
